description: Inverse squash hazard. REQ-003 step 3 deletes via `git branch -d` (merged-only). git treats squash-merged branches as NOT fully merged, so `git branch -d` refuses them (admitted at line 88). Combined with FIND-001, real squash-merged branches are neither classified reapable nor deletable -> the reap pipeline is inert for the actual production workflow it was built to clean.

evidence.snippet: execute in order: `git worktree remove <path>` then `git branch -d <branch>`. ... `git branch -d` refuses because branch is unmerged ... do NOT use `-D`.

fix: Specify safe squash reap: confirm merge via patch-equivalence/gh PR state, accept that `git branch -d` refuses, define operator-gated `-D` path OR rely on GitHub delete_branch_on_merge for remote and require explicit operator confirmation for local squash-merged branches.
